summary: 114줄 검사기에 선언된 경로 주장 대조를 추가하고 가드레일을 동기화했다. 반증 2건·37항목·lint 통과, report 126개 전수 집계(paths_verified 292·expected_absent 6·source 263), 기존 실패 9개 보존.

behavior: Recursively inspect only list-valued paths_verified, paths_expected_absent and fabricated_paths declarations.
paths_verified accepts a string or an object with path; only exists:false claims absence, and an omitted exists claims presence.
paths_expected_absent and fabricated_paths always claim absence, including object entries.
Path.exists() accepts regular files and directories. Relative claim paths use the repository root; report arguments/globs use cwd.
Source traversal, regular-file checks and JSON pointer resolution are unchanged.

tdd.method: The same temporary-fixture subprocess assertions ran before and after implementation; no persistent test file or existing test changed.
tdd.command:
@'
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
checker = root / 'scripts/check-citations.py'
cases = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='kijun-path-claims-') as name:
    folder = Path(name)
    report = folder / 'report.json'
    target = folder / 'target.json'
    target.write_text('{"array":[null],"a/b":{"~":false},"":0}', encoding='utf-8')
    plain = folder / 'plain.txt'
    plain.write_text('not json', encoding='utf-8')
    missing = str(folder / 'missing.json')
    def check(label, data, code=0, reasons=(), cwd=root):
        report.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding='utf-8')
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(checker), str(report)],
                                cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8')
        actual = [json.loads(line)['reason'].split(':')[0] for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
        passed = result.returncode == code and actual == list(reasons) and not result.stderr
        cases.append(dict(name=label, expected_exit_code=code, exit_code=result.returncode,
                          expected_reasons=list(reasons), stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr, passed=passed))
    check('verified string file', {'paths_verified':[str(plain)]})
    check('verified object exists true', {'paths_verified':[{'path':str(plain),'exists':True}]})
    check('verified object default present', {'paths_verified':[{'path':str(plain),'checked':True}]})
    check('verified string directory', {'paths_verified':[str(folder)]})
    check('verified object directory', {'paths_verified':[{'path':str(folder)}]})
    check('verified string missing', {'paths_verified':[missing]}, 1, ['path_claim_missing'])
    check('verified object missing', {'paths_verified':[{'path':missing}]}, 1, ['path_claim_missing'])
    check('verified true missing', {'paths_verified':[{'path':missing,'exists':True}]}, 1, ['path_claim_missing'])
    check('verified false missing', {'paths_verified':[{'path':missing,'exists':False}]})
    check('verified false file', {'paths_verified':[{'path':str(plain),'exists':False}]}, 1, ['path_claim_unexpected'])
    check('verified false directory', {'paths_verified':[{'path':str(folder),'exists':False}]}, 1, ['path_claim_unexpected'])
    for field in ['paths_expected_absent','fabricated_paths']:
        check(field+' missing string', {field:[missing]})
        check(field+' missing object', {field:[{'path':missing,'exists':False}]})
        check(field+' existing file', {field:[str(plain)]}, 1, ['path_claim_unexpected'])
        check(field+' existing directory', {field:[{'path':str(folder)}]}, 1, ['path_claim_unexpected'])
        check(field+' overrides exists true', {field:[{'path':str(plain),'exists':True}]}, 1, ['path_claim_unexpected'])
    check('nested declarations', {'items':[{'evidence':{'paths_verified':[missing]}}]}, 1, ['path_claim_missing'])
    check('undeclared path text ignored', {'fixture':missing,'path':missing,'commands':[missing],'notes':missing})
    check('non-list declaration ignored', {'paths_verified':missing})
    check('root relative independent of cwd', {'paths_verified':['scripts']}, cwd=folder)
    check('source directory stays invalid', {'source':str(folder)}, 1, ['file_missing'])
    check('source plain regular file', {'source':str(plain)})
    check('source missing', {'source':missing}, 1, ['file_missing'])
    check('source pointer null', {'nested':[{'source':str(target)+'#/array/0'}]})
    check('source pointer escapes', {'source':str(target)+'#/a~1b/~0'})
    check('source empty key', {'source':str(target)+'#/'})
    check('source root pointer', {'source':str(target)+'#'})
    check('source bad key', {'source':str(target)+'#/missing'}, 1, ['missing_key'])
    check('source bad index', {'source':str(target)+'#/array/1'}, 1, ['array_index'])
    check('source invalid pointer', {'source':str(target)+'#x'}, 1, ['invalid_pointer'])
    check('source invalid JSON', {'source':str(plain)+'#/x'}, 1, ['json_parse_error'])
    check('both kinds reported', {'source':missing,'paths_verified':[missing]}, 1, ['file_missing','path_claim_missing'])
failures = [c['name'] for c in cases if not c['passed']]
print(json.dumps(dict(total=len(cases), passed=len(cases)-len(failures), failed=failures, cases=cases)))
sys.exit(bool(failures))
'@ | python -X utf8 -

limitations: 선언되지 않은 경로 언급은 이 검사에서 경로 주장으로 취급하지 않는다. fixture·명령·diff·서술 문자열이 경로처럼 보여도 훑지 않으며 키 블랙리스트도 두지 않는다.
report가 근거로 삼은 경로는 해당 step 사양이 paths_verified에 선언하도록 요구해야 한다. 검사기 자체는 선언의 누락이나 증거의 완전성을 판정하지 못한다.
존재 여부는 실행 시점의 파일시스템을 기준으로 한다. 실제로 읽었는지, 파일 내용·해시가 주장과 일치하는지, 인용 내용이 참인지는 보증하지 않는다.
과거 report에서 발견한 실패는 기록만 하고 고치지 않는다. source가 문자열이면 기존 검사대로 검사하므로 자연어 source나 과거 임시 경로도 기존 실패로 집계될 수 있다.

census.method: Independent recursive field census plus a separate checker subprocess for every file and one aggregate glob run. Occurrences count, including repeated declarations; paths_verified includes exists:false entries, and expected_absent sums the two absence-list fields. source counts only string-valued source entries.
census.self_note: This report was written before the census and included in the glob. Adding census statistics/output adds no string-valued source or list-valued path declarations.
